title: Add Two Numbers II
inputFormat: Implement addTwoNumbersII(l1, l2). Arguments are linked-list heads with val and next fields; the examples display their node values as arrays.
outputFormat: The head of a new linked list containing the sum in most-significant-digit-first order. The runner displays its node values as an array.
